caption: The drawing depicts a triangular wooden plaque with a border, featuring a scene in its center. The scene shows a human figure with long, dark hair and a feather, riding a brown horse. The figure is holding a long stick or spear, pointed toward a brown bison positioned to the left. The ground beneath the horse and bison has green patches, possibly representing grass. The background within the triangle is shaded in a muted brown tone. The base of the plaque is a horizontal plank with two circular ends, each containing a white star-like design. The overall color palette includes browns, greens, and muted neutral tones. The composition is balanced, with the horse and rider to the right and the bison slightly to the left, all set against the wooden texture of the plaque.
title: Over Door Panel
